speaker: Doctor
text: Can you describe the double vision—do you see two separate images, or does one image appear blurred? Additionally, have you noticed any difficulty with swallowing or breathing?

speaker: Patient
text: The double vision usually happens when I look up or down, and the weakness in my arms and legs gets worse after activity but improves if I rest. I have not noticed balance problems or numbness.

speaker: Doctor
text: That pattern of worsening with activity and improvement with rest is very suggestive of myasthenia gravis. To confirm this, I need to check your eye movements and muscle strength more closely, and I will also request blood work to look for specific antibodies. REQUEST TEST: Acetylcholine_receptor_antibodies AND MuSK_antibodies. Please tell me if you experience any dry eyes or difficulty swallowing dry foods.
